title: Arakan Army Repels Junta Monsoon Offensive Near Kyaukphyu Naval Station
detail: Junta forces launched a surprise offensive on July 11, 2026, targeting Arakan Army (AA) positions near Awataung Village, Kyaukphyu Township, Rakhine State, banking on monsoon rain and darkness for tactical surprise against the deep-sea port and Chinese-linked economic zone. AA forces, which had monitored the troop buildup, repelled the advance; the junta column retreated in disarray on July 12, leaving behind bodies, weapons, and ammunition near Taungmaw Naval Station. Fighting resumed after the junta regrouped with reinforcements, with AA forces pursuing the retreating columns. The clash underscores the strategic stakes around Kyaukphyu, home to the $7.3 billion China-backed deep-sea port central to the China-Myanmar Economic Corridor.

media.caption: Junta forces retreat near Kyaukphyu Naval Station after heavy clashes with the Arakan Army.
